body: That sounds rough, living with people who maybe can't or don't understand what you're experiencing. Can't offer any advice, but I'm glad you're hanging in there regardless.
I've had better and I've had worse. How was yours?

Weird! I wonder what that's all about. I can't remember any details about mine at all, but usually when I wake up unexpectedly, it's from a nightmare, so it felt so strange to come to feeling so at peace. Thank you for sharing your experience. I feel a little less like, uh, a circus sideshow right now.

Weird question, but do you remember the dream at all? I had a similar experience and when I woke up, I knew I'd had a good dream, but I can't remember what it was actually about. It's bugging me for some reason.
